title: astragalus virgatus var. uralensis
intro: Astragalus virgatus var. uralensis, commonly known as Mongolian milkvetch, is a plant species belonging to the legume family, Fabaceae. This plant is traditionally used in folk medicine, particularly in Asia, to support immune function and alleviate symptoms of various health conditions. The health benefits of Astragalus virgatus var. uralensis include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and immunomodulatory effects, which are thought to contribute to its therapeutic actions of enhancing immune response and protecting against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, saponins, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
